items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: He played with me a long time. He played with me for nine months on the jungle roof.

ctx.x: Oh he did. He played with me a long time. He played with me for nine months on the jungle roof. I used to get the summer job at the White House at the Buena Vista. Those were the jobs that made music, just free share of stock in a golf club. That helps doesn't it?

items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: It was a higher type of a milious set, but I had Fazola on the clarinet, he was great.

ctx.x: But you had your ten piece band, it was more or less your society orchestra, you would call it... Well I played arrangements. I played arrangements. Then it's arrangements. Yes. And that was at the same...

And it picked up stocks. Yeah. And that was still during the twenties. It was a higher type of a milious set, but I had Fazola on the clarinet, he was great. You know heard of him? His name was... You know heard of Fazola? Yeah, I knew him. His name was Verstappen. That's his real name. That would be hard enough to pronounce. Oh, the greatest clarinet player of the lick. And people don't know it, he played a tenor saxophone. I used to play Spanish tunes, just to hear that guy play lead on it. Oh, he used to send…
